eligibility_test: parcel polygon ∩ unclipped buffer_edge_state.geojson and extras_{city}_simplified.geojson (cincinnati/norwood/reading/golf_manor/evendale). Same files and predicate as UI search / CHECK_LAYERS. Not classified from habitable-clip render polygons.
definition: Habitable addresses = CAGIS address points on Auditor residential CLASS parcels (same filter as build_surfaces.is_residential_class), point-in-polygon inside that municipality. Percent closed under state floor = (A − B) / A. Percent closed under state + ordinance = (A − C) / A. Ordinance increment = D as percentage points of A.
caveat: Eligible ≠ available or affordable. These are habitable addresses legally open under the mapped surfaces, not vacant, listed, or affordable units. Rental listing / asking-price data is not on disk and is not reachable here (no MLS, Zillow, or CHPL/HUD listing feed). CAGIS RENT_REG_FLAG is a parcel registration flag, not a listing or price. A later pass would need a licensed listing extract joined to these address points to report vacant or affordable stock.
